The bottom tray contains a claw hammer, additional screwdrivers with yellow handles, and other implements. The case features a central carrying handle and appears to be made of hard plastic.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The metal shafts of the screwdrivers lack realistic specular highlights and reflections; they appear somewhat matte or 'painted' rather than metallic. The plastic handles have a slightly uniform, waxy texture lacking fine manufacturing details like parting lines.
The tips of the yellow-handled screwdrivers in the bottom right seem to merge slightly into the plastic molding or each other, lacking distinct separation and sharp edges.

The geometry of the hammer head is slightly irregular; the claw curve looks subtly asymmetrical and the face of the hammer doesn't align perfectly with the handle axis, suggesting minor geometric warping.
